title: Trellis AI (YC W24)  hiring a product lead to build agents for healthcare access
summary: Trellis AI, a Y Combinator Winter 2024 cohort company, is hiring a product lead to develop AI agents focused on improving healthcare access. The company appears to be building AI-powered solutions to help people navigate and access healthcare services more efficiently.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of difficult healthcare access by building AI-powered agents to help users navigate the complex healthcare system.
why_valuable: Healthcare access remains a significant pain point for millions, and AI agents can provide 24/7 guidance, triage, and navigation support that scales beyond traditional healthcare staffing limitations.
